mentions.name: Free Horoscope API
mentions.description: A free horoscope API that serves around half a million requests per day. Originally built during covid and hosted on Vercel, it has since migrated to a proper domain and Cloudflare Workers, running at a monthly bill just under $10.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's a bit stupid but I made a free horoscope api during covid and hosted on vercel, it started getting a lot more traction since and I have migrated to a proper domain and to cloudflare workers. Getting around half a million request / day and bill is just below $10
mentions.author: rootsu
